notes.title: New dubbed version and shadow mode restored. Version 0.3a
notes.notes: This is merely a test...I don't know how long shall I wait for the next update. Looks like it's been a while...

notes.title: The last updated version before the PVE/LAN game mode project is getting started...
notes.notes:
Good day my friends,

Pandamonia v0.1g is released! This will be the last updated version before the PVE/LAN game mode project is getting started! It might take a long time for me to see you all again next time. So be aware of this, I'll try my best and thank you again for supporting.

Sincerely,
Hoffman Chang

notes.title: Pandamonia v0.3a released! This will be the last early-access state update!
notes.notes:
Hi there,

Pandamonia v0.3a released! After this update the early-access state of this game will be cancelled soon.Here are the updates below:

1 - final boss fight scene has been completed.
2 - final check section of the whole Pandamonia project has been started, this might last a few days, but not later than this April.

Thanks for supporting! I have to see a doctor on May Day since my personal health condition is getting worse these days. But don't worry I won't stop developing and upgrading though I cancel the early-access state of this game.Hope ya all can understand...

Sincerely,
Hoffman Chang

notes.title: There might be something wrong with v0.2d updated version yesterday...
notes.notes:
Hello my dear friends,

Something wrong happened while I was uploading my final v0.2d updated version yesterday, the network was shut down unexpectedly and some new features were lost. Today I've fixed this well. Thank you!

Yours,
Hoffman Chang

notes.title: Pandamonia v0.2d Final Update!(Date:2019-02-09)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

My Spring Festival holiday is over. Continue my working today.
This is the last v0.2d updated version. Some planting objects in level 1-2 have been removed in order to increase the game frame rate.

Yours,
Hoffman Chang

notes.title: Pandamonia Version 0.2b released.(Date:2019-01-24)
notes.notes:
Good afternoon my friends,

Pandamonia v0.2b released. Updates below:
1.Pandamonia Splash logo image added in start scene.
2.Character shadow on/off option is enabled now.

Thanks a lot!

Yours,
Hoffman Chang

notes.title: Pandamonia Version 0.2a released! (Date:2019-01-23)
notes.notes:
Hi there,

Version 0.2a has been released! Here are the updates below:

1.Episode II project has been activated! Day 16-18 unlocked.
2.One new rare gun(cannot be purchased from Hoffman) added - PPSH-A800 plasma submachinegun.

After Day 18 there's no longer defensive level existed, which counter-offence stories will replace(from Day 19-30). This will be shown in next version. 

Thanks for all your supportings! Cheers...

Yours,
Hoffman Chang

notes.title: Bugs fixed & Updates (Date:2019-01-10, version 0.2a released)
notes.notes:
I'm so sorry for all your inconvenience, here's the new updates and fixs:

1-Some character's corpse disappeared abnormally. This has been fixed.
2-Game tips added.
3-Enemies' AI improved.

Due to the inconvenient working and network condition right here, I might not be able to update the game very often but I'll try my best to overcome this. So many thanks for all ya guys' supporting and I'm sure I'll do much better.

Yours,
Hoffman Chang
